newsitem.title: HAITI: Beauty pageant will make a comeback in Haiti.
newsitem.headline: Beauty pageant will make a comeback in Haiti.

text.p: Reflecting the return of democracy to their country, Haitian belles are preparing to don swimsuits and strut onstage for the first Miss Haiti beauty contest in years.
"In the past, government officials would just choose someone," promoter Rodney Daniel said on Thursday. "Often there just wasn't the money to put together a real pageant."
About 25 contestants will vie for the title on Dec. 28, but the winner will not be able to compete for the title of Miss Universe 1997.
"The Miss Universe pageant is changing ownership, so they cannot accept new countries next year," Daniel said. But he hopes to enter next year's Miss Haiti in the 1998 competition.
"I don't think Haiti has ever sent a contestant to Miss Universe," he said.

The promoter hopes the contest will attract tourists to the impoverished country. "I know my country needs to work on its image," he said. "There are a lot of beautiful, intelligent people here, but the rest of the world only hears about the bad things that happen."
